description: Public v0.5.25 validation: normalized two-photon HOM interference, bunching and reference visibility.

regression_tests.note: Measured full public live suite with LEAN_VERIFIER_LIVE_TESTS=1.

raft_state_machine_scope.log_matching: local preservation under explicit input compatibility and freshness premises

chip_layout_scope.external_sha256_binding: checked by Python converter; not formally verified

raft_complete_bridge_scope.regression: Actual 14-step execution: term-1 commitment, term-2 election of a different leader, general completeness and retention theorem applications.

schnorr_batch_scope.regression: Exhaustive counts over ZMod 3, deterministic cancellation, zero residuals, single coordinate and zero rounds.

quantum_sql_scope.regression: Unequal coefficients with optimum I=2; tight calibration; failed bound without calibration and outside positive-intensity domain.

marzullo_scope.regression: Touching singleton, disconnected feasible set, misleading maximum, duplicate sources, empty/zero/impossible thresholds.

transcript_forking_scope.regression: Exact finite counts, tight/strict bounds, threshold, ZMod 5 extraction, noninjective encoding, and combined matrix bridge.

beam_splitter_scope.regression: Transparent/reflecting/unbalanced/balanced splitters, signed amplitude, nonunit input norm, bunched probabilities, polynomial substitution and path-probability contrast.

simon_scope.promise: nonzero s and f(x)=f(x′) iff x=x′ or x=x′ XOR s
simon_scope.recovery: rows orthogonal to s with binary span dimension n-1; solutions exactly {0,s}

statement_conformance_scope.satisfiability: Concrete n=1,m=0 promise and n=1 empty-row rank-zero recovery witnesses only.
statement_conformance_scope.comparison: Definitional equality against pinned gold definitions and constructor field types.

ricart_agrawala_scope.nodes: Fixed Fin n, including all n>=2; proofs also cover n=1, and n=0 has no requests.
progress_contracts: eventual REQUEST and sent REPLY receipt
weak fairness for continuously enabled reply sends and entry

qpe_general_scope.target_dimension: arbitrary finite d; normalized eigen-input required for output probabilities
qpe_general_scope.lower_bound: 4/pi^2 for either nearest tie, including wrap-around

progress_assumptions: weak fairness of continuously enabled send and enter

quotient_criterion_assumptions: each q in qs divides r
shor_order_recovery_scope.spectral_criterion: LCM(map (r/gcd(s,r)) ss) = r iff gcd(r,foldr gcd 0 ss) = 1, for r > 0 including empty ss

raymond_tree_scope.nodes: Fin n; fixed connected acyclic graph and designated initial owner
raymond_tree_scope.safety: Reachable-state token conservation and mutual exclusion without fairness
raymond_tree_scope.holder_routing: Simple paths end at owner or in-flight destination; virtual-root outgoing pointer suppressed
raymond_tree_scope.queue_nodup: Derived from request accounting; ordinary queue lists
progress_contracts: eventual delivery of every sent REQUEST and in-flight PRIVILEGE
weak fairness of assign/makeRequest local handlers
raymond_tree_scope.exact_traffic: Each message kind has dist(u,initialOwner) sends at completed entry from quiescent initialization with only client u; arbitrary legal interleavings

pedersen_homomorphic_sum_scope.group: Abstract finite AddCommGroup with Module (ZMod q) and cardinality q
pedersen_homomorphic_sum_scope.generators: Both nonzero; no known DLOG relation required
pedersen_homomorphic_sum_scope.homomorphism: Arbitrary finite weighted sums, including empty and all-zero families
pedersen_homomorphic_sum_scope.hiding: Exact equality with the uniform PMF
pedersen_homomorphic_sum_scope.aggregate_hiding: Fixed coefficients/messages; one nonzero weighted fresh independent uniform mask; arbitrary joint law of other masks
pedersen_homomorphic_sum_scope.collision_extraction: Different messages imply different masks and explicit DLOG formula

schnorr_identification_scope.setup: Reuses Pedersen prime-order group Setup; only nonzero g is used; h can equal g
schnorr_identification_scope.public_statement: X only; witness relation X=x*g; every statement has a unique witness
schnorr_identification_scope.completeness: Every honest transcript accepted for every nonce and challenge
schnorr_identification_scope.special_soundness: Same R, two distinct challenges, two accepting transcripts imply nonzero denominator and exact witness extraction
schnorr_identification_scope.hvzk: Exact equality of complete transcript PMFs, with pair-law corollary
schnorr_identification_scope.independent_challenge_law: Nonce is sampled first in the real experiment; any independent challenge PMF is permitted
schnorr_identification_scope.exact_support: Accepting transcripts with the specified challenge

chandy_lamport_general_scope.topology: Finite directed graph, edge-indexed FIFO queues, arbitrary payload and application state; self-loops allowed
chandy_lamport_general_scope.snapshot: One instance; atomic capture and outgoing marker append; application traffic before and after
chandy_lamport_general_scope.cut_safety: Pre-cut receipt implies matching pre-cut send; phase stamps linked to strict application event order
chandy_lamport_general_scope.channel_recording: Exact ordered list with identities and multiplicities; stable after closure
chandy_lamport_general_scope.local_snapshot: Actual local value and event counter; never overwritten
chandy_lamport_general_scope.termination: Finite common completion index from directed reachability, eventual offering/processing of each queued item, and weak fairness of continuously enabled local snapshot reactions
chandy_lamport_general_scope.reliability_boundary: End-to-end eventual head offering or processing; stronger than transport no-loss alone; does not assume global completion
chandy_lamport_general_scope.non_fifo_counterexample: Only adjacent message/marker swap is added; an old packet is missing from a closed record
chandy_lamport_general_scope.disconnected_counterexample: Reliable fair trace with unreachable node never completes

dj_balanced_scope.definitions: Reuses Bits, IsBalanced, runDJ and outcomeWeight from QuantumDeutschJozsaGeneral
dj_balanced_scope.bijection: Explicit inverse support and characteristic maps; restriction to half-cardinality supports for n>=1
dj_balanced_scope.count: choose(2^n,2^(n-1)) for n>=1; zero at n=0; counts 0,2,6,70
dj_balanced_scope.interference: Balance iff zero amplitude iff zero probability in the existing circuit, without DJPromise
dj_balanced_scope.promise: Paired zero/balanced and one/constant equivalences under DJPromise
dj_balanced_scope.witness: First-bit projection for every positive n
dj_balanced_scope.fin_bridge: Bits n equivalence with Fin (2^n) preserves trueCount and IsBalanced

photonics_phase_scope.operators: B=[[sqrtT,i sqrt(1-T)],[i sqrt(1-T),sqrtT]], D=diag(exp(i phi),1), U=B†DB
photonics_phase_scope.probability_definition: Complex.normSq of the actual matrix output on input (1,0)
photonics_phase_scope.unitarity: Both matrix inverse laws; preservation of Hermitian Euclidean norm for arbitrary complex vectors
photonics_phase_scope.probability: P0=1-4T(1-T)sin²(phi/2), P1=4T(1-T)sin²(phi/2); nonnegative, total one, 2pi-periodic, endpoint cases
photonics_phase_scope.scalar_bridge: Balanced intensities equal SolarisMithraCore formulas, total input power conserved
photonics_phase_scope.visibility: Attainable extrema I0 and I0(2T-1)²; valid MithraicPhaseCollapse pattern; balanced visibility one
photonics_phase_scope.static_offset: Same intensity bounds and attained extrema at shifted phases, not decoherence
photonics_phase_scope.geometric_phase: phi=kappa*DeltaL+phi0 is an explicit external premise

hom_interference_scope.construction: Normalized symmetric square derived by homogeneous polynomial substitution from imported complex B(T)
hom_interference_scope.unitarity: Both matrix inverse laws and preservation of squared Hermitian norm for arbitrary complex inputs
hom_interference_scope.output: Input |1,1> maps to (i sqrt(2TR),T-R,i sqrt(2TR)); probabilities (2TR,(2T-1)^2,2TR)
hom_interference_scope.phase_bridge: Single-mode diag(1,i) induces diag(1,i,-1); general inputs rephased, |1,1> only changes by global phase
hom_interference_scope.distinguishable_reference: Nonnegative normalized joint weights from independent labeled paths; product of actual marginals; coincidence T^2+R^2 >= 1/2
